description: As cpu, with Parabricks DeepVariant on 4 GPUs of an L40S node (12 minutes per sample on the GPU instead of 65 core-hours; jobs serialise on a single GPU node, and Parabricks calls about 10 % fewer indels than CPU DeepVariant, so benchmark against a truth set before production). gpu_type sets the gres type and travels into every task's inputs: projects with different gpu_type values share no call cache.
